components.note: CNN 恐懼與貪婪指數由 7 個因子等權組成：市場動能（S&P 500 相對 125 日均線）、股價強度（創 52 週新高與新低的家數）、股價廣度（上漲股與下跌股的成交量）、選擇權賣權／買權比、市場波動（VIX 相對 50 日均線）、避險需求（股票與債券 20 日報酬差），以及垃圾債需求（垃圾債與投資級債的利差）。台灣的恐懼與貪婪指數依此架構略做調整：部分因子在台灣無法找到直接對應的資料，因此改以相近的台灣市場資料替代，例如以台灣與美國公債殖利率利差取代垃圾債需求，共 8 個面向。各面向的數值為其在歷史區間中的相對位置（0–1）。另附今日在全部歷史資料中的百分位（50＝歷史中位數），顏色與狀態依百分位判斷。

strategy.name: 策略回測
strategy.note: 本站DCA加值法以 TWGFI 等指標在 0050、正二與現金之間切換。曲線為回測淨值（起點＝100），以隔日開盤價成交、已扣手續費與證交稅；非實際帳戶績效，過去表現不代表未來。分散版為研究中的候選規則：資金平均分在兩種不同的恐懼判斷上，降低單一判斷失準的影響；尚未用於本站策略，僅供比較。「無kf濾網」為同一套DCA加值法拿掉 kf 濾網後的對照，用來看濾網本身的增減。

table.note: 定期定額：每月第一個交易日投入 1 萬元（已扣手續費）；各擇時策略另於市場下跌達一定幅度時額外投入，故累積投入較多，期末市值不宜直接相比。策略績效（時間加權）：不受投入金額與時點影響的淨值表現，用來比較策略本身。年化 TWR（時間加權報酬）＝（∏（1＋rₜ））^（365.25÷期間日曆天數）－1，rₜ 為每日報酬（隔日開盤價成交、已扣手續費與證交稅）；期間內無資金進出，故與淨值的年複合成長率相同。XIRR 依投入金額與時點加權：下跌時額外投入的資金，在上漲年常落在相對高檔、留在市場的時間也短，因此有額外投入的策略 XIRR 可能低於只做定期定額的 0050，即使策略本身表現較好；比較策略優劣請以年化 TWR 為主。

en.CNN 恐懼與貪婪指數由 7 個因子等權組成：市場動能（S&P 500 相對 1: The CNN Fear & Greed Index combines 7 equally weighted factors: market momentum (the S&P 500 versus its 125-day moving average), stock price strength (stocks at 52-week highs versus lows), stock price breadth (volume in advancing versus declining stocks), the put/call options ratio, market volatility (the VIX versus its 50-day moving average), safe-haven demand (20-day stock versus bond returns), and junk bond demand (the spread between junk and investment-grade bonds). The Taiwan Fear & Greed Index follows this framework with slight adjustments: some factors have no direct counterpart in Taiwan, so similar Taiwan market data are used instead — for example, Taiwan and US government bond yield spreads replace junk bond demand — for a total of 8 components. Each component's value is its relative position within its historical range (0–1). Today's percentile within the full history is also shown (50 = historical median); colors and status labels follow the percentile.
en.但市場廣度極低，代表指數雖強，上漲的基礎並不寬廣。: but market breadth is extremely low, meaning that although the index is strong, the rally rests on a narrow base.

en.動能轉弱 + 股不如債 + 弱勢股主導，築底或延續下行。: Weakening momentum + stocks lagging bonds + weak stocks leading: either bottoming out or continuing lower.
en.台灣實務版 TWGFI · 本站主要參考指標: TWGFI Taiwan Practitioner Version · this site's primary reference
en.國際慣例版 · 對齊 CNN 方法: International Convention Version · aligned with the CNN method
en.在 8 個面向之外再加入 3 項資金與籌碼面向，數值為過去一年百分位；僅供參考，: Adds 3 capital-flow aspects on top of the 8 standard ones; the value is a 1-year percentile. For reference only — not used in our daily report or daily video.
en.定期定額：每月第一個交易日投入 1 萬元（已扣手續費）；各擇時策略另於市場下跌達: Monthly investing: NT$10,000 on the first trading day of each month (net of fees); the timing strategies also invest extra when the market falls by a set amount, so they invest more in total and their ending values should not be compared directly. Strategy performance (time-weighted): NAV performance unaffected by the amount and timing of contributions, used to compare the strategies themselves. Annualized TWR (time-weighted return) = (∏(1 + rₜ))^(365.25 ÷ calendar days in the period) − 1, where rₜ is the daily return (filled at the next day's open, net of fees and transaction tax). With no cash flows during the period, it equals the compound annual growth rate of the NAV. XIRR is weighted by the amount and timing of contributions: in a rising year, extra money invested on dips often goes in at relatively high prices and stays invested only briefly, so a strategy with extra investments can show a lower XIRR than plain monthly investing in 0050 even when the strategy itself performed better. Use annualized TWR to compare the strategies.
en.已還原除權息與分割，較早的價格會低於當時實際報價。: Adjusted for dividends and splits; earlier prices appear lower than the actual quotes at the time.
en.市場廣度 0.00（參與度極低／多數個股偏弱；歷史第 5 百分位）: Market breadth 0.00 (very narrow participation / most stocks weak; historical percentile 5)
en.市場弱勢 0.70（強勢股動能不足；歷史第 5 百分位）: Market weakness 0.70 (strong stocks lack momentum; historical percentile 5)
en.把各面向依方向拆成兩側，看多空力量各自來自哪裡。: Components are split by direction to show where bullish and bearish forces come from.
en.擴充版 TWGFI-11 · 國際慣例＋資金與籌碼面向: Extended TWGFI-11 · International Convention + capital-flow aspects
en.數值為 v3 分數在自身過去三年（約 756 個交易日）中的百分位，取 5 日平: The value is the percentile of the v3 score within its own past three years (about 756 trading days), averaged over 5 days. v3 follows the CNN convention (low volatility is read as the absence of panic), so its raw score runs persistently high and is shown as a percentile instead. Each component is normalized using only data available at the time, so historical values are not revised as new data arrive.
en.新低多於新高: More new lows than new highs
en.月頻資料，公布後才更新；日線上為沿用前值，非每日變動。: Monthly data, updated only after each release; the daily series carries the latest release forward and does not change daily.
en.本站DCA加值法以 TWGFI 等指標在 0050、正二與現金之間切換。曲線為回: Our DCA Plus strategy switches among 0050, a 2x leveraged 0050 ETF, and cash based on TWGFI and other indicators. Curves show backtested NAV (start = 100), filled at the next day's open and net of brokerage fees and securities transaction tax. This is not actual account performance; past performance does not guarantee future results. The diversified variant is a research candidate: capital is split evenly between two different fear signals to reduce the impact of either one being wrong. It is not used by our strategy and is shown for comparison only. "No kf filter" is the same DCA Plus strategy with the kf filter removed, shown to isolate the filter's own effect.

en.資金密度：上市與上櫃近 20 個交易日的平均成交金額，除以加權指數每千點，代表指: Capital density: average TWSE + TPEx turnover over the past 20 trading days divided by the TAIEX in thousands of points — how much trading value stands behind every 1,000 index points. The level has risen over time, so it is compared by its past-year percentile. It describes how deep the market's money is, not market direction.
